task: Na e-shope vyhladaj knihu "Duna" od Franka Herberta. Ak je dostupne, pridaj ho do kosika. Nakoniec otvor kosik.

goalSpec.goal: Search for the book 'Duna' by Frank Herbert, add it to the cart if available, and open the cart.
successCriteria: The book 'Duna' is found and added to the cart.
The cart opens successfully after the book is added.
goalSpec.stopCondition: The cart is displayed on the page.
assumptions: The website allows searching for books by title.
The book 'Duna' by Frank Herbert is available for purchase.

subtasks.title: Add 'Duna' to the cart.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cart count updates to reflect one additional item.

stopReason: The book Duna is already in the cart, and the cart dropdown is open on the current page showing the item and a visible 'Zobraziť košík' button.
finalVerdict: Kniha "Duna" od Franka Herberta je už v košíku. V košíku sa zobrazuje aj tlačidlo "Zobraziť košík". Môžete prejsť na stránku košíka, ak potrebujete ďalšie informácie.

visualFinalVerdict.reason: Deterministic final gate is not yet satisfied.
